title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ps69: SOS POST response code regression (CHANGED→CREATED breaks test, violates RFC 7252)
description:
git diff HEAD~1 HEAD changes `render_post` in `SosResource` from returning `aiocoap.CHANGED` to `aiocoap.CREATED`. Two problems:

1. **Test failure**: `tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py:117` asserts `resp.code == aiocoap.CHANGED`. The test was not updated, so this change will cause it to fail.

2. **RFC 7252 semantics incorrect**: `SosResource` is a singleton resource — POST activates/changes SOS state on the existing `/sos` resource. It does NOT create a new sub-resource (no `Location-Path` returned). Per RFC 7252 §5.8, 2.01 CREATED is only appropriate when a new resource is created; for an update to an existing resource, 2.04 CHANGED is correct.

The fix should either:
- Revert to `aiocoap.CHANGED` (correct for current singleton model), OR
- If switching to collection semantics, also update: test assertion, add `Location-Path` option, and create sub-resources under `/sos/<id>` per spec §18.4.5 which models SOS as a list of active alerts.

Changed file: `python/src/lichen/coap/resources.py` line 745.
